age.evidence: MIK2-HA proteins used for mass spectrometry analysis were isolated from 35S::MIK2-HA transgenic Arabidopsis seedlings with anti-HA agarose. About one 1,000 of two-week old 35S::MIK2-HA transgenic Arabidopsis seedlings grown on 1/2 MS plates were frozen in liquid nitrogen, thoroughly ground in a mortar, and resuspended in protein extraction buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl, pH7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 10 mM DTT, 0.4% [v/v] Triton X-100, 0.2% [v/v] NP-40 and protease inhibitor cocktail from Sigma).
